findings.finding: The source supports the first-principles campaign guidance, while the candidate clearly labels orchestration, retry, and signature mechanics as platform-added.
The pinned runtime executes preflight, generation, evaluation, waiting_independent_review, and reviewed stages and keeps can_execute false.
Review verification is bound to workspace, campaign, stable run ID, and artifact hash through the fixed owner-controlled verifier registry; self-selected keys and non-independent identities fail.
Campaign review is a local Python owner API rather than a separately exposed MCP tool; operational documentation should identify the controlled invocation path.

method: Verified all first-principles quotes and source hash; matched the pinned runtime hash; searched registry ownership; exercised every declared stage, durable restart, cancellation, terminal handling, and Ed25519 review acceptance with planted wrong-workspace, wrong-artifact, self-signed, principal-identity, repeat-review, and unsafe-registry cases.
ownership_decision: Register as the Creator Platform brief-to-campaign harness. It owns this local staged workflow and should compose with broader campaign and independent-review capabilities rather than replace them.
